en.tagline: Asks which skill or flow fits your situation
en.summary: ask-matt is a router over the skills in this repo. You describe where you are, and it names the skill or flow that fits. It also shows how the skills connect, from an early idea to a shipped change.
problem: You may not remember every skill in the repo, so you may not know which one to run first. The skills also work in a set order, and some steps are easy to skip or run at the wrong time.
With ask-matt, you ask where you are. It names the skill or flow for that point and how it links to the others. It reads each skill's SKILL.md before it says what that skill does.
fit: You have an idea and want it built, but you are not sure of the first step
A pile of bugs or feature requests needs triage before work starts
A large effort is too big for one session and the path is unclear
You need to choose between continuing, clearing, compacting, or handing off a session
unfit: You already know which skill you want to run
Your task does not involve the skills or flows in this repo
steps: You ask which skill or flow fits your situation.
It reads the SKILL.md of any skill it is about to describe.
It places your situation on the main flow from idea to ship, on an on-ramp, in codebase upkeep, or on a standalone path.
It names the next skill and any decision you need to make first, such as whether the work spans several sessions.
If you are at a phase boundary, it points you to the guidance on choosing between continuing, clearing, handing off, using a subagent, or compacting.

zh.tagline: 询问哪个技能或流程适合你的情况
zh.summary: ask-matt 是本仓库技能的路由工具。你说明当前情况，它会指出合适的技能或流程，并说明各技能之间如何衔接，从最初的想法到最终交付。
problem: 你可能记不住仓库里的每个技能，因此不清楚应该先运行哪一个。这些技能有固定的先后顺序，有些步骤容易被跳过，或者在不恰当的时候执行。
使用 ask-matt 时，你只需说明当前所处的阶段。它会指出对应的技能或流程，以及它与其他步骤的关系。在说明某个技能的作用之前，它会先阅读该技能的 SKILL.md。
fit: 你有一个想法，想把它做出来，但不确定第一步该做什么
积压了一批 bug 或功能请求，开工前需要先分类整理
一项大型工作超出单次会话的范围，而且路径还不清楚
你需要在继续、清空、压缩或交接会话之间做出选择
unfit: 你已经知道要运行哪个技能
你的任务与本仓库的技能和流程无关
steps: 你询问哪个技能或流程适合你的情况。
在介绍某个技能之前，它会先阅读该技能的 SKILL.md。
它把你的情况放到对应位置：主流程（从想法到交付）、入口分支、代码库维护，或独立路径。
它指出下一步该用哪个技能，以及你需要先做的决定，例如这项工作是否跨越多个会话。
如果你正处于阶段边界，它会指引你查看相关说明，帮你在继续、清空、交接、使用子代理或压缩之间做出选择。
